name: North American Electric Reliability Corporation
summary: North American Electric Reliability Corporation appears in Part 13 of The Buildout. Part 13: The Ratepayer Pays First. Argued in Part 13 (The plant is late).

mentions.excerpt: The North American Electric Reliability Corporation, NERC, noted in an assessment of the Midwest grid that for two years industry projections of new resources had outpaced what was actually completed, held back by supply chains, permits and developers' own decisions.
